306 days before 01-23-1475:  
1475 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Subtract 306 days:  
Jan 23 minus 23 days → Jan 1.  
306 − 23 = 283 days left to subtract from Jan 1 of 1474 (since going back past Jan 1).  
1474 is not a leap year (divisible by 2, not by 4).  
283 days before Jan 1, 1474:  
Dec 31, 1473 minus 1 day → Dec 30, 1473.  
283 − 1 = 282 days left.  
Go back through 1473 (not leap year):  
282 days before Dec 30, 1473:  
Subtract 31 days of Dec → Nov 29, 1473.  
282 − 31 = 251 days left.  
Subtract 30 days of Nov → Oct 30, 1473.  
251 − 30 = 221 days left.  
Subtract 31 days of Oct → Sep 29, 1473.  
221 − 31 = 190 days left.  
Subtract 30 days of Sep → Aug 30, 1473.  
190 − 30 = 160 days left.  
Subtract 31 days of Aug → Jul 30, 1473.  
160 − 31 = 129 days left.  
Subtract 31 days of Jul → Jun 29, 1473.  
129 − 31 = 98 days left.  
Subtract 30 days of Jun → May 30, 1473.  
98 − 30 = 68 days left.  
Subtract 31 days of May → Apr 29, 1473.  
68 − 31 = 37 days left.  
Subtract 30 days of Apr → Mar 30, 1473.  
37 − 30 = 7 days left.  
Subtract 31 days of Mar → Feb 27, 1473.  
7 − 31? That’s wrong — I made a mistake: March has 31 days, so going from Apr 29 back 30 days lands on Mar 30, correct. Then 37 days left before Mar 30.
